nodes.name: What's New in Workday

Tenanted_Report_Definition_Data.Name: What's New in Workday
Tenanted_Report_Definition_Data.Instructions:
You can view results for all functional areas enabled in your tenant, select specific functional areas from the prompt, or both. Filter by Workday Release to see all items delivered to Production within a release, or specify dates to return week-by-week results for Preview or Production delivery, including corrections.

The Enabled Functional Areas check box results include all What's New items in the System functional area. These items are tagged with System subcategories in the results and may also be tagged with Functional Areas that are disabled in your tenant.

The Coming Soon value in the Tenants prompt enables you to filter for early What's New documentation that we publish 1 week before the Preview feature release. Items are only marked Coming Soon in the week prior to the Preview feature release, after which we update them to show the tenant we deliver them to.

Important: Use the System Subcategories prompt to narrow results for features in the System functional area. You must have System enabled in your tenant or selected in the prompt to have a System Subcategory impact your search results.
